{{Quote|You've got the Force around you boiling like pletik soup.|Laranth Tarak mentioning the soup when speaking with Jax Pavan|<ref name="Twilight" />}}
'''Pletik soup''' was a type of soup that was boiled.<ref name="Twilight" /> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Laranth Tarak]], a [[Gray Paladin]], told the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], [[Jax Pavan]], that [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] was boiling around him like Pletik soup before he asked Tarak to help him find [[10-4TO]], a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that Pavan's [[Death/Legends|dead]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]], [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]], tasked him with locating.<ref name="Twilight" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pletik soup was first mentioned in ''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]'', a [[2008]] novel written by [[Michael Reaves]].<ref name="Twilight" /> On [[March]] [[March 11|11]], [[2011]],<ref name="Airdate">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode320.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Citadel Rescue}}</ref> "[[Citadel Rescue]]," an episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] Even Piell's death to occur in the episode,<ref name="Citadel">{{TCW|Citadel Rescue}}</ref> instead of the novel,<ref name="Twilight" /> making it ambiguous how the events of the novel fit in with the altered continuity.
